sources.notes: CT DEEP calendar-year guide. Furbearer Seasons table on p.36; pelt-tagging schedule and protected-species rule on p.36. Archived locally in hidden_files/season-research/connecticut/.

license_summary.trapping_license: Trapping license required; available 24/7 via Connecticut's Online Outdoor Licensing System or at licensed retailers/town halls.
license_summary.pelt_tagging: Beaver, river otter, red fox, gray fox, wild mink, coyote, and fisher pelts must be tagged by DEEP before sale/exchange/gift/disposal/retention (by the last scheduled tagging date of the season).
license_summary.fisher_carcass: Fisher carcass submission to the Wildlife Division is mandatory.
license_summary.state_land: State-land trapping permits $60 per unit (east/west of the Connecticut River), valid November through March 31.

verification.confirmation_notes: 2026 CT Hunting and Trapping Guide (final, calendar-year). Furbearer Seasons table p.36: otter Jan 1-Mar 15 & Nov 8-Dec 31 (limit 8); beaver Jan 1-Mar 31 & Dec 1-Dec 31 (no limit); mink/muskrat/weasel/coyote/gray fox/red fox/raccoon/opossum/skunk Jan 1-Mar 15 & Nov 8-Dec 31 (no limits); fisher Nov 20-Dec 31 (limit 2, carcass submission mandatory); pelt-tagging species list; bobcat confirmed PROTECTED (no open season) via the protected-species pelt rule on p.36.
known_gaps: CT publishes calendar-year guides; the 2027 guide (setting January-March 2027 furbearer dates) is not published as of 2026-09-18. season_year='2026', provisional=true; only the two published 2026 segments are modeled and nothing about 2027 is inferred.
